messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing an inference performance readout next Wed 10:00am PT (~30m). Proposed agenda:
1) benchmark results for v0.9 quantized pipeline
2) latency + cost dashboard highlights (what changed since last run)
3) canary rollout plan & fallback thresholds

Who can present the bench results? pinging @devon and @aj to lead different sections. Please react with availability or suggest an alternative slot.

aj: I can take latency graphs + methodology. Wed or Thu works for me.
Can you drop the run_id and the benchmark config here so I can prep the slides? Also quick ask — do we want to include the longer-seq (4k+) runs in the main deck or an appendix?

maria: We'll include long-seq in the appendix unless we see major regressions. Run id is run_2026_03_10_q8 (sharing artifacts after this thread).

devon: I can cover cost/unit and cache effectiveness. Need the KV cache hit-rate numbers and the run metadata (batch sizes, quant type). If anyone has the perf trace for the bad tail latencies, pls share.

sajal: Heads-up I'm OOO Wed morning. If nobody can move, I can watch recorded session and follow up. If we shift to Thu 9:30am PT I'm available live.

maria: I'd prefer Wed for cadence, record it, and @sajal we can sync afterward for any follow-ups.

aj: Small prep note — I'll run the dashboard export script, please ensure prometheus snapshots are up-to-date. Command I use locally:
```bash
./bench/run_benchmark.sh --config configs/q8_v0.9.yaml --out artifacts/run_2026_03_10_q8
```
Will anyone own uploading the artifact bundle to the drive?

devon: I'll upload the bundle (artifacts + cost csvs) by EOD. Also pinging bench-bot to post the artifacts link when available.

bench-bot: scheduled-upload: artifacts for run_2026_03_10_q8 queued (owner: devon). Link will be posted when upload completes.

maria: Also quick ops: can someone review PR #3456 (serving fallback thresholds)? I want it merged before the readout so we can demo the canary. @devon @aj

devon: I'll do the first pass. Leaving comments inline.

aj: I can review after devon. If we keep reviews light, we can merge by EOD.

maria: Thanks — if merged, please ping me so I can add the change to the deck.

sajal: Proposed agenda tweak: add a 5-minute risk worksheet at the end (known regressions and mitigations). Good to surface before canary.

maria: Good call — adding a 5-min risk block. Final agenda now: bench results (20m), canary plan (5m), risks (5m).

devon: :+1: I'll prep cost slides and a two-slide appendix for long-seq.

aj: :+1: I'll prep latency slides and the dashboard export.

both: :thumbsup:

maria: Recording + slides will be posted in #eng-ml after the meeting. If anyone needs to swap presenters, flag here by EOD.

bench-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled -> Wed 10:00am PT. Recording enabled.

maria: Thanks all — agenda locked for Wed 10. See you then.
